source: Released metric_definitions.csv plus reviewed BQ-006/BQ-010 template contracts; no evaluation questions

metrics.name: Roll rate
metrics.definition: Share of accounts in a bucket at the start of the period that are in a worse bucket at the end
metrics.example: Roll rate from 1-30 to 31-60 this month by product?

metrics.name: Cure rate
metrics.definition: Share of cases open at the start of the period that return to current within the period
metrics.example: What was the cure rate for cases opened in August?

metrics.name: Promise-kept rate
metrics.definition: Share of resolved promises that were kept in full
metrics.example: What is the promise-kept rate this month by queue?

metrics.name: Broken promise rate
metrics.definition: Share of resolved promises that were broken

metrics.name: Right-party contact rate
metrics.definition: Share of outbound call attempts that reached the customer
metrics.example: RPC rate by hour of day last month?

metrics.name: Cost per contact
metrics.example: Cost per contact by channel this month?

metrics.name: Cost per right-party contact
metrics.definition: Total contact cost divided by right-party contacts

metrics.name: Amount collected
metrics.definition: Payments received on cases in the period
metrics.example: How much did we collect in September?

metrics.name: Hardship rate
metrics.definition: Share of cases with financial hardship recorded

metrics.name: Delinquency rate
metrics.definition: Share of active accounts 1+ days past due
metrics.example: Card delinquency rate by bucket today?

metrics.name: Write-off rate
metrics.definition: Share of accounts charged off in the period
metrics.example: Write-offs in the last 12 months by product?

metrics.name: Average days past due
metrics.example: Average DPD of open cases by queue?

metrics.name: Payroll delay share
metrics.definition: Share of customers with a payroll deposit more than 7 days late
metrics.example: How many open-case customers have payroll more than a week late?

metrics.name: Out-of-hours call share
metrics.definition: Percentage of outbound calls outside permitted calling hours using the supplied flag, grouped by province.
metrics.example: What share of outbound calls were outside permitted hours by province?

metrics.name: Dispute count
metrics.definition: Count of customer disputes raised about fees during two comparison periods.
metrics.example: How many fee disputes were raised compared with the preceding period?
